answer: A workshop can stamp thousands of unpaid keys overnight. Admission parks each applicant on a ledge, a 19-minute bench holding only one live credential. The applicant must culture a pearl: three signed work beads, hashed as H(bead, prior, bench-id), taken 36 minutes apart by inspectors from three foundries. They lock 17 POA for 5 epochs and post 0.29 POA as a copper tag on every bead. Peers recompute the bead chain and confirm each copper tag remains escrowed. A shared ledge, missing bead, or cashed copper tag slashes 27 percent to the reporting inspector and quarantines the key for 5 epochs.
